transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2026-06-25
Start: 14:00 UTC
Duration: 58 minutes
Attendees: Lena Park (Redwood AE), Marco Rivera (Redwood SE), Priya Shah (Redwood CSM), Carl Nguyen (Northstar Procurement), Aisha Hassan (Northstar Legal), Diego Morales (Northstar Platform Eng), Ruth Bennett (Northstar Security)

Summary:
Quick procurement handoff to legal and security; finalize MSA redlines, DPA exceptions, confirm KMS/SAML requirements and SLA tiers, and agree next steps for a short Dedicated pilot and technical pre-checks for private deployment. Pricing draft to be delivered for a 12-month commit.

Topics:
- MSA redlines and non-negotiables
- DPA exceptions (data residency, subprocessors)
- SLA targets and remedies (p99 latency, uptime SLA)
- Private deployment / VPC & KMS options
- Pricing for Dedicated capacity and pilot format

Transcript body:
[00:00:03] Lena Park: Hi everyone, thanks for joining, uh we wanted to keep this focused — procurement, legal and security aligned then pass to SE for tech pre-check. Quick intros?
[00:00:12] Carl Nguyen: Carl, procurement, thanks. We'll mostly be looking at terms, financials and approval path.
[00:00:18] Aisha Hassan: Aisha, legal. We'll focus on MSA/DPA redlines, data residency and subprocessors.
[00:00:22] Marco Rivera: Marco, SE. I'll dig into deployment constraints and capacity numbers.
[00:00:27] Diego Morales: Diego, platform. I own the private deployment checklist.
[00:00:31] Ruth Bennett: Ruth, security — SOC2 / KMS / SSO questions.
[00:00:34] Lena Park: Great. High-level ask from Northstar was to see a redlined MSA with clear SLA commitments and a DPA that matches your residency and retention needs. We also promised a pricing sketch for dedicated capacity.
[00:00:47] Carl Nguyen: Correct, and timeline is procurement committee on July 7th. So we need final reviewed docs before then ideally.
[00:00:53] Lena Park: Understood. We'll aim for June 29 for the initial redlines.
[00:00:58] Aisha Hassan: Two things I want noted early — one, we will likely ask for a limitation on subprocessors and a right to audit clause in the DPA. Two, indemnity language in MSA needs sharpening.
[00:01:12] Lena Park: Got it, we'll flag those. On subprocessors we can provide the vendor list and an architecture note — sometimes the auto-transcribe calls it 'sub-proces-sors' in my notes, haha.
[00:01:21] Ruth Bennett: On KMS — is customer-managed KMS supported for Private? We need HSM-level key controls for some workloads.
[00:01:28] Marco Rivera: Short answer: yes for Private deployments we support customer KMS integration. For hosted there is a bring-your-key option for certain plans but it's limited. For Dedicated private, we can route through your KMS, but we'll need a runbook exchange.
[00:01:41] Diego Morales: When you say "route through KMS" do you mean envelope encryption or full key ownership?
[00:01:45] Marco Rivera: We typically do envelope encryption with customer-managed CMKs in the cloud KMS. For on-prem/HSM we can provide a connector — it's an integration project.
[00:01:53] Ruth Bennett: Ok please put that in the DPA/ops annex.
[00:01:57] Priya Shah: (joins in) Hi all — Priya from CSM, will own the pilot scheduling and success criteria. I'll capture the SLOs we need to track.
[00:02:05] Lena Park: Thanks Priya. Carl, can you remind us of the priority SLOs procurement is expecting?
[00:02:11] Carl Nguyen: Uptime commitment first, then p99 latency for inference calls. We also want an audit trail of who accessed logs and transcriptions.
[00:02:19] Aisha Hassan: And retention options per dataset — Northstar has strict retention windows for PII.
[00:02:24] Marco Rivera: On latency we usually publish model-level p50/p95/p99 on the console, but SLAs are at the service level. There might be a small mismatch — I'll annotate that in the SLA annex.
[00:02:36] Lena Park: If you recall, our Dedicated offering gives a committed throughput with an SLA for availability and quicker fallbacks. Hosted has best-effort performance SLAs.
[00:02:45] Carl Nguyen: We're most interested in predictable cost and isolation — Dedicated is appealing but need the pricing.
[00:02:50] Lena Park: We'll include a draft pricing for a 12-month reserved pool with burst capacity.
[00:02:55] Diego Morales: For the pilot, we need to know the expected QPS and sequence sizes — typical tokens per request. Diego: we use conversational transcripts averaging 600 tokens but spikes reach 2,000.
[00:03:07] Marco Rivera: That's helpful — please send us a sample workload. We'll use it to pick quantization and batching policies.
[00:03:13] Diego Morales: Will do.
[00:03:15] Aisha Hassan: On DPA exceptions — we may need an exception for cross-border subprocessors if you use multi-region caching.
[00:03:22] Marco Rivera: We have prefix caching and KV cache that can be region-restricted. I might say 'K-V cache' in notes, the transformer libs sometimes get mangled in transcripts.
[00:03:31] Ruth Bennett: Does Redwood offer per-route RBAC and audit logs that map to our SSO groups?
[00:03:36] Marco Rivera: Yes, RBAC is supported via SAML/SCIM integration — though SAML sometimes shows up as 'sam el' in quick notes. We'll provide the SSO integration guide.
[00:03:45] Ruth Bennett: Good, need to validate SCIM provisioning and log retention.
[00:03:50] Lena Park: We'll attach the security pack (SOC 2 Type II, pen test summary) with the MSA packet. Note: SOC2 might be referenced as 'sock two' in prev calls, so just FYI.
[00:03:59] Aisha Hassan: Any change to liability caps? We need to know if there's negotiation room.
[00:04:04] Lena Park: We usually have standard caps, but for enterprise commitment we can discuss limited upward adjustments. I'll flag commercial for pricing team.
[00:04:10] Carl Nguyen: Timeline again — procurement committee July 7th. We need reviewed docs 3 business days prior.
[00:04:16] Lena Park: Action: we'll target June 29 for redlines.
[00:04:20] Priya Shah: I'll coordinate pilot dates. Does a 2-week pilot sound right?
[00:04:25] Diego Morales: 2 weeks plus a performance window would work.
[00:04:30] Marco Rivera: For technical pre-checks we'll need your VPC peering and firewall rules, and a representative service account for KMS testing.
[00:04:37] Diego Morales: I'll share firewall egress rules and a stakeholder for the test account.
[00:04:41] Aisha Hassan: Can you also include the subprocessors list and any FedRAMP/FedRAMP-like statements? We may not be FedRAMP but need to know controls.
[00:04:49] Lena Park: We'll include the vendor subprocessors and a control summary. We don't currently have a FedRAMP cert — we'll be explicit about that.
[00:04:55] Ruth Bennett: For encryption at rest and in transit — confirm TLS1.2+/AES256?
[00:05:00] Marco Rivera: Yes TLS1.2+, AES-256; for in-flight tokens we use modern ciphers.
[00:05:05] Carl Nguyen: Ok good. On pricing — can you provide a deterministic per-token and per-embedding rate for reserved capacity plus a delta for burst usage?
[00:05:13] Lena Park: Yes that's in the pricing workbook we'll send. We'll call out per-token tiers and burst surcharges.
[00:05:18] Aisha Hassan: About data residency — we need logs and raw transcripts to remain in EMEA for a subset of tenants. Is that doable?
[00:05:26] Marco Rivera: We can route requests to EMEA-backed Dedicated pools and ensure KV cache resides in-region. I'll annotate region routing in the deployment annex.
[00:05:36] Diego Morales: Are there any networking egress charges we should expect?
[00:05:40] Lena Park: We'll call out estimated egress and show options to optimize with caching.
[00:05:44] Priya Shah: Quick note — we'll also propose a success metric: throughput stability >95% and P99 under target for pilot.
[00:05:52] Marco Rivera: Action item for me: run a capacity estimate based on Diego's numbers and propose a Dedicated pool size.
[00:05:58] (cross talk)
[00:06:03] Lena Park: Ok let's jump to the MSA redline specifics — Aisha, what are 2-3 must-haves?
[00:06:08] Aisha Hassan: Liability cap alignment, clear definition of 'confidential information', and breach notification SLA.
[00:06:15] Lena Park: We'll highlight those sections.
[00:06:18] Aisha Hassan: Also request data deletion certification after termination for certain datasets.
[00:06:22] Ruth Bennett: And a retention carve-out for logs used in security investigations.
[00:06:26] Lena Park: Noted.
[00:06:29] Carl Nguyen: From procurement side, can we get a one-pager on billing cycles, invoice timing and early termination fees?
[00:06:35] Lena Park: Yes — billing and termination scenarios part of the pricing packet.
[00:06:39] Priya Shah: Re: pilot measurements, we'll instrument token-level cost tracking and a per-route latency dashboard so Northstar can see cost/latency tradeoffs.
[00:06:48] Marco Rivera: We'll also include model and quantization suggestions to hit a cost target.
[00:06:52] Diego Morales: If quantization changes affect output quality we need evals.
[00:06:56] Marco Rivera: Absolutely — we'll run an eval suite against your prompt subset.
[00:07:00] Lena Park: Any other blockers we should note?
[00:07:03] Carl Nguyen: Only procurement signoff timeline and legal redlines.
[00:07:06] Aisha Hassan: Nothing else from legal right now.
[00:07:09] Ruth Bennett: Security will review the security pack and schedule a short follow-up if anything pops.
[00:07:14] Lena Park: Ok recapping next steps now.
[00:07:16] (brief silence)
[00:07:20] Lena Park: Recap: Redwood will send MSA redlines + DPA checklist + security pack and pricing workbook by June 29. Marco will send capacity estimation and private deployment notes by July 2. Diego will provide workload samples by June 28. Priya will schedule pilot kickoff for the week of July 6.
[00:07:37] Carl Nguyen: That aligns with our procurement timeline.
[00:07:41] Aisha Hassan: Agreed.
[00:07:43] Priya Shah: I'll send calendar invites after Lena's packet is published.
[00:07:47] Lena Park: Great. Any final questions?
[00:07:50] Diego Morales: Just a clarification on the pilot — will Dedicated pilot be fully isolated or a shared pool with reservation?
[00:07:57] Marco Rivera: We can do a short-term isolated Dedicated pool for the pilot if contractually ok — will reflect in pricing.
[00:08:04] Ruth Bennett: Please include the isolation guarantees in the pilot doc.
[00:08:07] Lena Park: Will do.
[00:08:09] (silence for 10s)
[00:08:19] Lena Park: Thank you everyone. We'll follow up via email and attach the docs.
[00:08:23] Carl Nguyen: Thanks.
[00:08:25] Aisha Hassan: Thanks all.
[00:08:27] (call ends)

Notes on transcription: occasional word swaps (e.g., 'SOC2' transcribed as 'sock two', 'SAML' as 'sam el'); speaker tags may be generic in the automated export.

- Marco Rivera: Capacity estimate and private deployment runbook by 2026-07-02
- Diego Morales: Provide workload sample and token profile by 2026-06-28
- Aisha Hassan: Return any DPA exceptions and carve-outs by 2026-06-30
- Priya Shah: Schedule pilot kickoff and circulate invites for week of 2026-07-06
